comment: Provisional Pakistan terminal manoeuvring area (TMA) boundaries from Pakistan AIP 2025 and supplementary Lahore 2022 OpenAir geometry; for testing and review, not operational navigation.
author: Dr Jamie J. Alnasir, PakAviation.com
info: Pakistan provisional terminal control areas — Lahore, Karachi and Multan; source Pakistan AIP ENR 2.1 (March 2025) and 2022 Lahore OpenAir boundary reconstruction.
_status: PROVISIONAL — NOT VALIDATED FOR OPERATIONAL FLIGHT NAVIGATION
_coverage: Lahore TMA: 1 Class C feature; Karachi TMA: 2 altitude-band features (Classes C and A); Multan TMA: 1 Class E feature; Islamabad TMA South: 2 altitude-band features (Classes C and A); Islamabad TMA West: 2 altitude-band features (Classes C and A).
_important: Karachi Class C lower altitude varies by CTR location (FL150 within / FL50 outside). File uses the FL50 outer base throughout the circle, which misrepresents the base within CTR. Lahore boundary and CTR exclusions also provisional. Multan AIP quotes 2500 ft AMSL and FL55 beyond the CTR; polygon follows CTR arc. Check current AIP/NOTAMs and official chart before use.
_AIP_version: Pakistan AIP AIRAC AMDT 01/25, ENR 2.1-4 to 2.1-5, dated 20 MAR 2025; Lahore 2022 OpenAir supplement

properties.SRC: Uzair Suria, PakistanOpenAir.txt (2022); Pakistan AIP ENR 2.1-5 (20 MAR 2025)
properties.NOT: 2022 polygon reconstruction. Arc centre in source differs from AIP 2025 by ~1.17 NM. The final ~8 NM straight boundary segment is inferred; CTR exclusion (inside 25 NM from SFC to FL075 per AD 2.17) is NOT subtracted. Do not use for operational navigation.

properties.FREQ: Karachi APP 125.500 MHz (published frequency); 121.300 MHz; 121.500 MHz emergency
properties.GEOMETRY_STATUS: AIP 2025 50 NM geodesic circle; current chart not checked
properties.LOWER_LIMIT_NOTE: Within the lateral limits of Karachi CTR, base is FL 150; beyond CTR, base is FL 50. A single full-circle polygon cannot display both limits correctly in Enroute.
properties.NOT: PROVISIONAL BASE SIMPLIFICATION: Enroute displays FL 50 for entire circle, but Karachi TMA Class C does not extend below FL 150 inside Karachi CTR (OPKC AD 2.17). Karachi CTR itself is Class B, SFC-FL150 in supplied AIP. Do not rely on this for airspace avoidance.

properties.FREQ: Karachi APP 125.500 MHz (published frequency); 121.300 MHz; 121.500 MHz emergency
properties.GEOMETRY_STATUS: AIP 2025 50 NM geodesic circle; current chart not checked
properties.NOT: Full 50 NM TMA circle as published; Class A at and above FL 155. Upper boundary FL 250. Validate against current AIP before operational use.

properties.GEOMETRY_STATUS: Based on published vertices and clockwise 20 NM arc centred on Multan VOR; current chart not checked
properties.LOWER_LIMIT_NOTE: ENR 2.1 states 2500 FT AMSL, with FL 55 beyond CTR. This polygon follows the CTR 20 NM arc and lies substantially outside the CTR, so the outer TMA segment is labelled FL 55. The CTR is not included in this dataset.
properties.NOT: Geometry is reconstructed from AIP ENR 2.1, including its clockwise 20 NM arc. The original AIP 2500 FT AMSL text and CTR qualification are preserved in LOWER_LIMIT_NOTE. Verify vertical limits and geometry on the current TMA chart.
